title: Sunlight on the Waterwheel
description: Ride three paddle-wheel carousels and the great wheel itself; sluice currents push and drag over bramble basins while icicle drips fall through the machinery. Expert redesign: counterturning waterwheels and pressurised sluices.

identity.scope: Decoration reference route; not a final five-minute stage

rooms.name: The riverside path
rooms.lesson: Ride the sluice current, hop the root beds. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

rooms.name: The mill approach
rooms.lesson: Board the paddle wheel to the sluice walk. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

rooms.name: Sunlight on the waterwheel
rooms.lesson: Ride the great wheel to the high sluice. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

rooms.name: Behind the mill
rooms.lesson: Mind the dripping machinery and the sluice tongues. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

rooms.name: The rocky upstream
rooms.lesson: One last wheel before the rocks. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.
